templates.title: Ask for a Google review
templates.when: Send to one happy client at a time, soon after a good result. Never offer anything in return, and don't suggest what they should say.
subjects: A quick favour, [First name]?
Would you share your experience on Google?
Two minutes that would really help us
templates.preview: It takes about two minutes and makes a real difference.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

Thank you for trusting {firm} with [the work we did together]. It has been great working with you.

Most people find us through Google, so a short review makes a real difference. If you are happy to leave one, this link takes you straight there:

{google_review}

It could be as simple as what you needed help with and how it went. An honest review is all we are after.

Thank you,

{signoff}

templates.title: Ask for a Facebook recommendation
templates.when: Best for clients you know are active on Facebook. Never offer anything in return, and don't suggest what they should say.
subjects: Would you recommend us on Facebook, [First name]?
A quick favour on Facebook?
templates.preview: A sentence or two from you helps other business owners find us.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

Thank you for trusting {firm} with [the work we did together]. It has been great working with you.

A recommendation from a real client means more than anything we could say about ourselves. If you are happy to leave one, you can do it on our Facebook page:

{facebook}

A sentence or two in your own words is plenty.

Thank you,

{signoff}

templates.title: Ask for a testimonial
templates.when: For your website and marketing. Get the client's approval of the final wording, and of using their name and business, before you publish it.
subjects: Could we feature your experience, [First name]?
Would you say a few words about working with us?
templates.preview: A few sentences in your own words, or I can call and write them down for you.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

I have really enjoyed working with you over [time period], and I wondered if you would be happy to say a few words about the experience for our website and marketing.

If it helps, these questions are a good starting point:

- What was going on in your business before you came to us?
- What has changed since?
- What would you tell another business owner thinking of working with us?

You can reply to this email, or I can give you a call and write down what you say. Either way, I will send you the final wording to approve before we use it.

Thank you,

{signoff}

templates.title: Ask for a case study
templates.when: For a client with a clear result. Confirm with them what can be shared, especially any numbers, and get their approval before publishing.
subjects: Could we share your story, [First name]?
10 minutes to talk about your results?
templates.preview: A short chat about what has changed in your business.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

The progress you have made with [result or project] is the kind of story other business owners would find useful, and I would love to write it up as a short case study for our website.

It would only take about 10 minutes on a call. I would ask why you came to us, what it has been like working together and what has changed since.

You would see the finished piece before anything is published, and you decide what is shared. We can leave out figures or your business name if you prefer.

Does a quick call this week suit you? Let me know a time that works, or book one here: {booking_url}

Thank you,

{signoff}

templates.title: Ask for a referral
templates.when: Works well after a good result or a thank-you from the client. Describing your ideal client gets better introductions.
subjects: Do you know anyone we could help, [First name]?
We'd love more clients like you
templates.preview: Most of our best clients come through people like you.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

We really enjoy working with you, and we would love to work with more business owners like you. Many of our best clients come through introductions from people they trust.

Is there anyone you know who might value some help? A good fit for us is [describe your ideal client, for example an owner-run trades business].

If someone comes to mind, feel free to pass on my details or let me know and I will get in touch. There is no pressure on them at all, and we would start with a friendly chat.

Thank you,

{signoff}

templates.title: Referral with ready-made introduction
templates.when: Use when a client has said they know someone. It gives them wording they can forward, which makes it much more likely to happen.
subjects: An easy way to introduce us
Thank you, [First name], and a suggested introduction
templates.preview: Some wording you can copy, so it only takes a minute.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

Thank you for offering to introduce us to [their contact's name]. To make it easy, here is something you could send them. Please change anything you like, and copy me in so I can take it from there.

"Hi [their contact's name], I would like to introduce you to [Your name] at {firm}, who I work with. I think it would be worth having a chat with them about [what they need help with]. They are easy to talk to and there is no obligation."

Thank you so much. We really appreciate it.

{signoff}

templates.title: Thank a client for a referral
templates.when: Send as soon as you receive the introduction, whether or not it turns into work. Don't mention anything confidential about the person referred.
subjects: Thank you for the introduction, [First name]
That was very kind of you
templates.preview: We really appreciate you thinking of us.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

I just wanted to say thank you for introducing us to [their contact's name]. We really appreciate you thinking of us, and it means a lot that you would recommend {firm}.

We will look after them.

Thank you,

{signoff}

templates.title: Ask for feedback
templates.when: Send once or twice a year. Add a link to a survey if you have one; otherwise the two questions work as a simple reply.
subjects: How are we doing, [First name]?
Two quick questions about working with us
templates.preview: Your honest answer helps us look after you better.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

Thank you for your support this year. We want to keep getting better at looking after you, and your honest answers would really help.

Could you reply with a line or two on these?

- What do we do well?
- What is one thing we could do better?

There are no wrong answers, and I read every reply.

Thank you,

{signoff}

templates.title: Welcome a new client
templates.when: Send on the day they sign up. Add what you need from them first, so they know exactly what happens next.
subjects: Welcome to {firm}, [First name]
Great to be working with you, [First name]
templates.preview: What happens next, and how to reach us.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

Welcome to {firm}. We are really pleased to be working with you.

Here is what happens next:

- [First step, for example we send your engagement letter]
- [Second step, for example you share access to your accounting file]
- [Third step, for example we meet to agree your priorities]

If you have a question at any point, just reply to this email or call us on {phone}. No question is too small.

We look forward to working with you.

{signoff}

templates.title: Deadline reminder
templates.when: Send about two weeks ahead so clients have time to act. Your next key date is filled in where we can; check it applies to the people you are sending to.
subjects: Coming up: {deadline}
A quick reminder about an upcoming date
Is this on your radar, [First name]?
templates.preview: A quick reminder, and what we need from you.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

A quick reminder about an upcoming date: {deadline}.

To keep things simple, here is what we need from you by [date you need it]:

- [What to send or do]
- [What to send or do]

If we already look after this for you, you don't need to do anything unless we have asked. If you are not sure whether it applies to you, just reply and we will check.

Thank you,

{signoff}

templates.title: Year-end is coming
templates.when: Send four to six weeks before the year ends, while there is still time to plan.
subjects: Getting ready for the {year_end}
Time to plan ahead, [First name]?
Let's get ahead of the {year_end}
templates.preview: We are booking clients in now, and planning early pays off.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

The {year_end} is coming up, and we are starting to book clients in now.

The weeks before year end are also the best time to look at your position, while there is still time to do something about it. Leaving it until afterwards usually means fewer options.

If you would like to talk it through, or get your work booked in early, you can reply to this email or choose a time here:

{booking_url}

Kind regards,

{signoff}

templates.title: Holiday closing hours
templates.when: Send two weeks before you close, and consider a reminder a few days before.
subjects: Our holiday hours
We'll be closed from [closing date] to [reopening date]
templates.preview: When we are closed, and how to reach us if it's urgent.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

Thank you for your support this year. It has been a pleasure working with you.

Our office will be closed from [closing date] and we will be back on [reopening date]. If there is anything you need from us before then, please let us know by [last day for requests].

For anything urgent while we are away, please email {email} and we will reply as soon as we can.

We hope you get some time to relax.

Warm regards,

{signoff}

templates.title: Check in with a quiet client
templates.when: For a client or past enquiry you haven't spoken to in a while. Keep it personal; mention something specific if you can.
subjects: How is business going, [First name]?
It's been a while, [First name]
templates.preview: No agenda, just checking in.

templates.title: Share a useful tip
templates.when: A simple format for one useful idea. Add your own experience: that is what makes it sound like you.
subjects: {topic}
A quick thought for you, [First name]
templates.preview: One practical idea you can use this week.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

[Why this matters right now, in a sentence or two.]

[The practical tip, or two or three short points.]

If you would like to talk about what this means for your business, reply to this email or choose a time here:

{booking_url}

Kind regards,

{signoff}

templates.title: Promote business advisory
templates.when: Best for clients you already do compliance work for. Mention something you have noticed in their business if you can.
subjects: Ready to grow your business, [First name]?
Got a lot on your plate? We can help
Making big decisions with better numbers
templates.preview: Clear numbers and a second opinion for the decisions that matter.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

When you are running a business, there is rarely enough time to step back and look at the numbers, let alone work out what they mean for your next decision.

That is where our business advisory service comes in. We can:

- Track how your business is performing and explain it in plain language
- Build a budget and cash flow forecast you can actually use
- Help you think through big decisions before you commit

If you would like to see whether it is a good fit, let's have a chat. There is no obligation.

{booking_url}

Many thanks,

{signoff}

templates.title: Promote virtual CFO services
templates.when: For growing businesses without a full-time finance lead. Only send if you offer this service.
subjects: Do you have a full handle on your finances, [First name]?
Senior finance support, without the full-time cost
Ready to take your business to the next level?
templates.preview: Learn more about our virtual CFO services.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

As a business grows, the financial decisions get bigger, but most businesses don't need or want a full-time finance executive.

Our virtual CFO service gives you that senior support when you need it, including:

- Strategic financial advice and planning
- Clear, accurate reporting
- Cash flow management
- Better financial systems and processes

We will start by understanding your goals and priorities, then agree what support makes sense.

If you would like to find out more, reply to this email, call us on {phone} or choose a time here:

{booking_url}

Have a great day,

{signoff}

templates.title: Promote one of your services
templates.when: Pick one service and one type of client. A specific problem gets far more replies than a list of everything you do.
subjects: {service}: could we take this off your plate?
Is this taking up too much of your time, [First name]?
templates.preview: How we can help, and what the next step looks like.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

Many business owners tell us that [the problem this service solves] takes up more time and energy than it should.

Our {service} service is designed to help. Here is how it works:

- [What we do]
- [What you get]
- [How it makes life easier]

You can read more here: {service_link}

If you would like to talk it through, reply to this email or choose a time here:

{booking_url}

Kind regards,

{signoff}

templates.title: Invite clients to an event
templates.when: Send three to four weeks before the event. Lead with what they will learn, not the event itself.
subjects: You're invited: [event name]
Join us on [event date], [First name]
Learn how to [event outcome]
templates.preview: Practical ideas you can use straight away, and it's free to attend.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

We would love you to join us for [event name], where we will be sharing practical ideas on [main topic].

You will come away knowing:

- [What they will learn]
- [What they will learn]
- [What they will learn]

Here are the details:

Date and time: [date and time]
Where: [venue or online link]
Cost: [free, or the cost]

To save your place, [how to register]. If you know someone else who would benefit, they are welcome too.

We hope to see you there.

{signoff}

templates.title: Invite prospects to an event
templates.when: For people who have agreed to hear from you, such as your mailing list. Add a comment from a past attendee if they have agreed to it.
subjects: Struggling with [problem]? Join us on [event date]
Free [webinar/seminar]: [event outcome]
templates.preview: A free session with practical ideas you can use straight away.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

If [the problem your event solves] is taking up more of your time than it should, you are not alone. We hear it from business owners all the time.

That is why we are running [event name], a free [webinar/seminar] on how to [event outcome].

Date and time: [date and time]
Where: [venue or online link]

Places are limited to [number], so please [how to register] by [closing date].

We hope to see you there.

{signoff}

templates.title: Last call for an event
templates.when: Send a few days before the event to people who haven't registered. Only mention limited places if that's true.
subjects: Last chance to join us on [event date]
Still time to join us, [First name]
templates.preview: A quick reminder before registrations close.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

A quick reminder that [event name] is coming up on [date and time], and registrations close on [closing date].

If you want to learn how to [event outcome], we would love to see you there. It takes less than a minute to [how to register].

Any questions, just reply to this email.

{signoff}

templates.title: Follow up after an event
templates.when: Send within a day or two, while it's fresh. This is where events turn into conversations.
subjects: Thanks for coming, [First name]
The notes from [event name]
templates.preview: The notes we promised, and a next step if you'd like one.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

Thank you for joining us at [event name]. I hope you came away with some useful ideas.

You can find the [notes, slides or recording] here: [link]

If the session raised any questions about your own business, I would be happy to talk them through. You can choose a time here:

{booking_url}

Kind regards,

{signoff}

templates.title: Follow up someone you met
templates.when: Send within a couple of days, and mention something they actually said. It's what stops this reading like a template.
subjects: Great meeting you at [event or place]
Following up from [event or place], [First name]
templates.preview: It was good to hear about your business.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

It was great to meet you at [event or place], and I enjoyed hearing about [something they said].

Based on what you told me, I thought it might be useful to mention [how we could help with what they described].

If you would like to talk about it, I would be happy to have a chat with no obligation. You can reach me on {phone}, or choose a time here:

{booking_url}

I hope to speak with you soon.

{signoff}

templates.title: Offer something useful after meeting
templates.when: A lighter follow-up when a sales conversation would be too soon. Ask first, and only add them to your mailing list if they say yes.
subjects: Good to meet you, [First name]
Something you might find useful
templates.preview: No sales pitch, just something that might help.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

It was great to meet you at [event or place].

I thought you might find our [newsletter or download] useful. It covers [what it covers], and our clients tell us it is worth a read.

Would you like me to send it to you?

All the best,

{signoff}

templates.title: One-to-one: share a business idea
templates.when: One-to-one only: send to one person you have researched, and never to a bought list. Spam rules differ by country, so check yours. Use a real result, and only name a client with their permission.
subjects: An idea for [their business]
A thought on [what you could improve], [First name]
templates.preview: It has worked for similar businesses, and takes 10 minutes to explain.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

I have an idea that could help [their business] with [what you could improve].

We used the same approach with [a similar business, or a client who has agreed to be named], and [the real result, with the time it took].

Would you be open to a 10-minute call to see whether it could work for you too? You can choose a time here:

{booking_url}

If this isn't relevant, just let me know and I won't follow up.

Thanks,

{signoff}

templates.title: One-to-one: a problem in their industry
templates.when: One-to-one only: send to one person you have researched, and never to a bought list. Spam rules differ by country, so check yours. The more specific the problem, the better.
subjects: Is [problem] a challenge at [their business]?
A common problem in [industry]
templates.preview: We see this a lot in your industry, and I have some ideas that might help.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

We work with a number of [industry] businesses, and one issue that keeps coming up is [a specific problem].

Recently we helped [a type of business] to [the real result].

If this is a challenge for you too, I would be happy to share a few ideas on a quick call. You can choose a time here:

{booking_url}

If it isn't relevant, just let me know and I won't follow up.

All the best,

{signoff}

templates.title: One-to-one: how we help businesses like yours
templates.when: One-to-one only: send to one person you have researched, and never to a bought list. Spam rules differ by country, so check yours. Say how you came across them.
subjects: How we help [industry] businesses like [their business]
Helping [their business] with [goal]
templates.preview: What we do for businesses like yours, and whether a chat makes sense.
templates.body:
Hi [First name],

I came across [their business] through [how you found them], and I am getting in touch because we work with a lot of [industry] businesses.

We help them to [the main results you get], by:

- [Benefit]
- [Benefit]
- [Benefit]

Would a quick call make sense to see whether we could help you too? You can choose a time here:

{booking_url}

If this isn't relevant, just let me know and I won't follow up.

Cheers,

{signoff}

Something useful for you, [First name]
